notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake.
When Scholar of the Ages and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker and up to one instant or sorcery to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
